Step-by-Step Guide

Tap any step timer to launch Cook Mode right there

restaurant_menu
1

Toss Filling & Line Baking Dish

Toss 3 cups crisp honeycrisp or granny smith apples (thinly sliced) with 2/3 cup brown sugar + 2 tbsp cornstarch. Fit 1 batch all-butter pastry crust (or crisp biscuit topping) into your dish and dot with 4 tbsp cold unsalted butter (cubed). Line your baking pan with parchment paper or grease lightly, and make sure 1 batch all-butter pastry crust (or crisp biscuit topping) and 4 tbsp cold unsalted butter (cubed) are measured and at room temperature so they blend smoothly.

lightbulb
Creator Secret

Cornstarch locks in juices so slices cut cleanly instead of turning watery.

2

Bake Until Jammy & Deep Golden

Brush top with 1 egg egg wash or heavy cream glaze and bake at 375°F (190°C) for 35 minutes until golden brown and bubbling. Let Apple crisp cool for 10–15 minutes so the crumb sets cleanly before slicing into 8 portions, then garnish and serve.

lightbulb
Creator Secret

Chill the filled crust 10 minutes before baking—cold butter hits the hot oven and puffs into extra-flaky layers.

ac_unit

Rest 20 minutes before slicing so the filling thickens to glossy jam consistency.

3

Bake Apple crisp & Check Doneness

Bake for 35 minutes until the edges turn golden and set while the center remains tender. Test with a toothpick—if it comes out with a few moist crumbs rather than wet batter, it is ready.

4

Cool Completely, Garnish & Serve

Transfer Apple crisp to a wire cooling rack and let it cool for 15–20 minutes so the interior sets cleanly without crumbling. Lift out using the parchment overhang, garnish as desired, and slice into 8 portions.

Nutrition, Storage & Healthy Prep Notes

CALORIES340 kcal
SERVINGS8
SUGAR MODEClassic

Make-Ahead & Storage: Keep apple crisp in an airtight glass container in the refrigerator for up to 4 days (or freeze individual portions up to 1 month). Pair with unsweetened Greek yogurt, fresh berries, or espresso for a balanced treat.

Keto & Low-Sugar Tip: Toggle Healthy Swap above to substitute refined sugar with monk fruit or coconut sugar and white flour with oat or almond flour.
